design_concept: Heritage-Modern Sports Premium. A fusion of 1852 legacy with cutting-edge commercial sports appeal. Confident, bold, highly legible, cinematic.

headings.usage: Used for main H1s, H2s, and section titles to establish heritage and premium positioning. Never center-align.

numbers_and_stats.usage: Used for oversized numerals, stat tiles (e.g., 234+, 1852), and high-impact data points. Tight tracking.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable grotesque sans for all paragraph text, tables, and UI elements. Avoid Inter and Roboto.

rules: Use Yellow surgically: CTAs, highlight numbers, key dividers. Do not overuse.
Backgrounds must remain deep authority black.
No purple/violet, no gradients, no AI slop styling.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire background to give an editorial print feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1) for structure, avoiding generic drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for the sticky nav. backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10

layouts.scroll_narrative: Default view. Continuous scroll with py-24 to py-32 section padding. Asymmetric bento grids and text/image overlaps.
layouts.presenter_mode: Toggled state. Each of the 16 sections becomes a 100vh slide. Uses Framer Motion AnimatePresence for smooth slide transitions. Includes keyboard navigation (left/right arrows) and a slide counter (e.g., '04 / 16').
layouts.spacing: Tailwind's generous spacing: p-8, p-12, p-16. Never cramp elements.
layouts.grid: Use 12-column layouts. Mix col-span-4 and col-span-8 to avoid perfect symmetry.

components.sticky_nav: Fixed at top. Deep black glassmorphism. Contains section jump links and a Presenter Mode toggle switch.
components.stat_tiles: Flat surface (no card shadow), 1px border. Oversized yellow Oswald font for the number, Manrope for the label.
components.ecosystem_map: Visual mapping of Youth/Competitive/Social/Ladies/Senior. Use a bespoke CSS grid layout connected with subtle SVG lines or border boundaries.
components.pathway_diagram: Youth-to-Senior timeline. Vertical or horizontal stepper using Yellow dots and white connecting lines.
components.sponsorship_table: Tier comparison (Title/Gold/Silver/Community/In-Kind). Clean rows, 1px bottom borders, checkmarks in Yellow. Investment column says 'On Request'.
components.inventory_grid: Bento-style grid detailing assets (Kit branding, digital, events).
components.presenter_toggle: Prominent but elegant UI switch. Can use an icon (Play/Slideshow) + text 'Presenter Mode'.

motion.scroll_reveals: Sections fade in and translate slightly up (y: 20 -> 0) on scroll using Framer Motion whileInView.
motion.slide_transitions: For presenter mode: subtle fade and x-axis translation (x: 50 -> 0).
motion.micro_interactions: Yellow elements scale up slightly on hover. Nav links get a yellow bottom border expand on hover.

image_urls.description: Wide shot of a lush green football stadium under lights. Perfect for the full-bleed cover section with a black/50 overlay.
Dramatic lighting under floodlights with players in the distance. Good for backing up text-heavy sections like 'Why SCC / Why Now'.
A classic heritage building with a clock tower. Use as a placeholder for the 1852 Heritage section.
Soccer team huddle wearing yellow kits. Extremely aligned with SCC's brand colors. Use in 'Football Ecosystem' or 'Partner With Us'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses a dark gradient or solid overlay (bg-black/60) to maintain WCAG AA compliance. Never use a fully transparent background behind text overlays.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Presenter mode MUST support left/right arrow keys to switch slides. Focus states for toggle buttons must use ring-primary_yellow.
accessibility.aria: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-mode application using React (.js files, no TypeScript). Use a global state or React Context to manage `isPresenterMode` (boolean).
In standard mode, map over the 16 sections rendering them vertically.
In Presenter mode, lock body scroll and render only the active section in a 100vh flex container with left/right arrow key listeners.
Implement Framer Motion for cinematic reveals and AnimatePresence for slide transitions.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards with white backgrounds and drop shadows. Use border-white/10 and flat dark surfaces.
Include Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Oswald, and Manrope in the index.html or import them in index.css.
Ensure the stat tiles have massive typographic impact.
Do not put actual pricing in the packages. Use 'Investment on request'.
Include data-testid on every clickable or interactable element.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid AI slop aesthetic. No purple/violet gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, not drop shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for navigation.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align dense content.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Missing categories (especially logos) = main agent will use placeholder text. Never use dummyimage URLs.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
